optional · the query leaves the organisation
1 Check quota, budget, answer cache; vague questions get a short reply
2 Limit the search to the tenant, knowledge base and ACL
3 Dense search in Qdrant + BM25 in PostgreSQL (+ picture vectors)
4 Fuse with RRF, rerank, drop weak ones; optional decision-model relevance gate
5 Send the evidence (and pictures) to the LLM, stream the answer; a loop guard cuts repeats
6 cite_check (decision model optional) fixes [n] markers; save message, usage, audit; trace
Transcript: you | AI in two columns
Max 15 min, one session per user
Results in SeaweedFS S3, owner only
Figure pages and images get a caption
Every query is filtered by tenant and ACL in the API, in Qdrant and by PostgreSQL row-level security. Drawn from the code in apps/api/hub.
Services: web (Next.js), api (FastAPI), worker + scheduler + ops-worker (Celery), postgres, redis, qdrant, seaweedfs, clamav (optional), llm-local (sleeps when idle); optional Langfuse stack.

The UI is in Thai and English (names are shown in the page language); voice chat accepts only Thai and English. Delivery: Docker Compose (dev, production, Dokploy, Langfuse overlay), loopback-only host ports, migrations run on start.
